title: TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2611.14491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series analytics has been widely applied across various domains. While existing time series foundation models (TSFMs) have demonstrated promising results, they still face two major challenges: 1) Most TSFMs mainly rely on stacking Transformer layers to increase parameter size, lacking the ability to adaptively model complex time series patterns from multi-domain data. 2) Current TSFMs are primarily pre-trained for specific tasks, e.g., forecasting or anomaly detection, and a few models support multiple tasks, but they fail to fully leverage task specificity and commonality, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose TimeSeek, a novel generalized time series analytics model that adaptively models time series patterns from multi-domain data and unifies multiple tasks in pre-training. Conceptually, TimeSeek is guided by selective information sharing under domain and task heterogeneity. From the perspec

translated_title: TimeSeek：面向广义时间序列分析的多任务与多领域预训练
translated_abstract: 时间序列分析已广泛应用于各个领域。尽管现有的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）已展现出令人鼓舞的结果，但它们仍面临两大挑战：1）大多数时间序列基础模型主要依靠堆叠 Transformer 层来增加参数规模，缺乏从多领域数据中自适应建模复杂时间序列模式的能力；2）当前的时间序列基础模型主要针对特定任务（如预测或异常检测）进行预训练，虽然少数模型支持多任务，但它们未能充分利用任务的特异性与共性，导致性能欠佳。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 TimeSeek，一种新颖的广义时间序列分析模型，它能够从多领域数据中自适应建模时间序列模式，并在预训练中统一多个任务。在概念上，TimeSeek 受领域与任务异质性下的选择性信息共享机制指导。
tldr: TimeSeek 通过领域与任务异质性下的选择性信息共享机制，实现了对多领域时间序列模式的自适应建模，并在预训练中统一多个分析任务，从而构建出性能更优的广义时间序列分析模型。
en_tdlr: TimeSeek is a generalized time series analytics model that adaptively models complex time series patterns from multi-domain data and unifies multiple tasks in pretraining, guided by selective information sharing under domain and task heterogeneity.
